report.summary: The app behaves as NTF-1 and NTF-2 require, so I changed nothing. Dana's account has no notifications in the data. `data/notifications.json` has `"dana": []`, and `GET /api/notifications` returns `[]` for her. Showing "You're all caught up" is therefore correct. The panel code (`public/src/notifications.js`) lists notifications newest first when there are any. It shows the empty message only after a successful read that returns nothing. A failed read shows "Could not load notifications." with a Retry button instead. Only `lee` has notifications (n-201, n-202). If Dana should be seeing notifications, the problem is in the data or in whatever creates them, not in the board. I can't tell from the repo whether notifications were meant to be addressed to her, so someone should check that upstream.
report.verification: I read the server, API client, panel and data files. I started the server on port 4199, which I stopped by process id afterward, and confirmed `/api/notifications` returns `[]`. `npm test` passed all 4 tests. I did not drive the page in a browser or run the Recovery Probe checks. I did not use plan_verification either, since I made no code change.
